KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

5. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

6. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

7. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

9. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain huyu na hawa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
